title: Weather
description: The temperature now in the menu bar; click it for feels like, high and low, rain chance, wind, the next hours and the next 7 days, and search its city on its page. Free data from Open-Meteo, no account or key.
examples: The menu bar shows ☀️ 24°: click it for the next six hours and the week ahead
On its page, type a city in Place and click it: the menu bar and the page show that city's weather

preferences.name: city
preferences.title: City
preferences.description: A city name, with its country after a comma when the name is common (Valletta, or Paris, France). Empty: the city of your Mac's time zone, so no location permission is asked. A city picked on Weather's page wins until this changes.

preferences.name: units
preferences.title: Units
preferences.description: Temperature, and wind in km/h or mph.
